title: PF2e Items - Sunder & Wear
description: Item durability for Pathfinder 2e: deliberate destruction and gradual attrition. Tracks HP, Hardness and materials for weapons, armour and gear, and adds an optional homebrew wear system — weapons wear down on a natural 1, armour when its wearer is critically hit, and every field repair permanently lowers what repair can restore. Heavily reworked fork of PF2e Aztec's Sundered by Aztec.

flags.credit: Author of PF2e Aztec's Sundered, which this module is based on

conflicts.reason: Both modules track the same item durability flags and inject the same controls
